# @prestgg/solid-ui

> shadcn/ui for SolidJS. Components are copied into your project, not imported.

Install: `bun add @prestgg/solid-ui solid-js`
Add a component: `bunx solid-ui@latest add button dialog`

## Documentation

- Full component reference with props and examples: https://shadcn-solid.dev/docs/components
- Every component in one file: https://shadcn-solid.dev/llms-full.txt
- CLI reference: https://shadcn-solid.dev/docs/cli

## Primitives

- `button`: The button, with six variants, eight sizes and asChild.
- `input`: A text input.
- `textarea`: A multi-line input that grows with its content.
- `label`: A form label, paired with a control through for/id.
- `badge`: A small status label.
- `card`: A surface with a header, content and footer.
- `separator`: A one-pixel rule.
- `skeleton`: A pulsing placeholder for content that has not loaded.
- `kbd`: A keyboard key, and a group of keys pressed together.
- `spinner`: A loading indicator, inline SVG with no icon dependency.
- `aspect-ratio`: A box that keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio.
- `table`: A data table with header, body, footer, rows and cells.
- `alert`: A callout with a title and a description.
- `avatar`: A portrait with a fallback.
- `breadcrumb`: The trail of ancestors for the current page.
- `pagination`: Page navigation, built from real anchors.
- `progress`: A progress bar, with an indeterminate mode.
- `checkbox`: A checkbox on a real input, so it takes part in form submission.
- `switch`: An on/off toggle on a real checkbox input.
- `radio-group`: Mutually exclusive options, on real radio inputs.
- `slider`: A range input over a styled track.
- `native-select`: The platform select, styled. For few options, where the native picker wins.
- `toggle`: A two-state button, announced with aria-pressed.
- `toggle-group`: Toggles that behave as one control, single or multi-select.
- `button-group`: Joins adjacent buttons or inputs into one control.
- `item`: One row of a list: media, text, actions.
- `empty`: The nothing-here-yet state, with a way out.

## Internal primitives

- `cn`: Class-name merger built on clsx and tailwind-merge. Every component uses it.
- `slot`: Radix's Slot for Solid: style the caller's element instead of the component's own.
- `polymorphic`: Render a chosen element and forward the rest, without a headless primitive.
- `variants`: cva-compatible variant function, without the dependency.
- `presence`: Keeps a subtree mounted until its exit animation has played.
- `focus-trap`: Confines Tab to a container and restores focus when it closes.
- `scroll-lock`: Reference-counted body scroll lock for nested overlays.
- `roving-focus`: The roving-tabindex pattern for menus, tabs and toggle groups.
- `floating`: Positioning for popovers, menus and selects, via @floating-ui/dom.
- `dismissable`: Close-on-outside-press and Escape, safe inside nested overlays.
- `portal`: Render into document.body, resolved lazily so SSR is safe.
